### Fixed
- **The kagent line re-pins to `v0.11.0-gs.3`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37010): the line's second automated re-pin (`sync-upstream.yaml`, 2026-09-11) moved the consumed branch onto upstream kagent-dev/kagent `main` @ `6a6b54ff` — kagent-dev/kagent#2786 (the Go ADK exports a turn's spans before its terminal event leaves the process), #2785 (the chart disables controller metrics when `bindAddress` is empty or `0`), #2797 (the built-in tool server's URL uses the `kagent-tools` namespace) — with the 21 carried patches replayed clean, none dropped. `v0.11.0-gs.3` (commit `ed07617b`) is that head. `kagent.tag` moves to `0.11.0-gs.3` (the controller and UI image build) and `kagent.harness.image` to the `gs.3` Go ADK index digest (meta and connectivity charts); `components.kagent`/`components.kagent-crds` keep the range `>=0.11.0-gs.1 <0.11.1-0`; the GRPCRoute service list is unchanged (no `proto/` change at the pin). Lab-proven on agentlab against the same tree (dev build `…hed07617`, the re-pinned build as charts, images and both platform Harness digests): `platform-test`, `agents-test`, `toolsets-test --skip-portal` and `skills-test` all green — agents reach Ready on the new Go ADK Harness, an A2A turn through the edge and a git-skill golden boot included. `examples/customer-bom.yaml` and `tests/verify-kagent-crds.py` (`KAGENT_LINE_REF`) move with the pin. **No installation acts** — the release stays inert behind the fleet's `<4.0.0` bound.
